body:
Regular use of a Shungite pyramid is said to balance and regulate your energy field, completely neutralizing it to correct any imbalances while also strengthening and reenergizing it. It is a tool of electromagnetic protection and a contributor to the process of healing electro-sensitivity. It acts as a protector and a transformer of any negative, harmful or electromagnetic energy. Shungite also does not take a charge when exposed to EMFs.

Since ancient times, the pyramid was considered a very powerful and sacred geometrical shape. It is much appreciated for its beautiful structure that represents both stability in its foundation, and focus in its point. The shape of a pyramid allows it to harness a higher vibration of energies, as it soaks up energy from the Earth and sends it upward. Due to their shape, a shungite pyramid is extremely beneficial for being able to focus the shungite properties and release them into your space.

Said to be around 2-billion years old, Shungite is only found in one place on the Earth - in the Russian part of Karelia. Composed mostly of pure carbon, it is the only known natural mineral to contain fullerenes, which are specific molecular formations of carbon that act as a powerful, long-lasting antioxidant. The discovery of fullerenes earned Robert F. Curl Jr., Sir Harold W. Kroto and Richard E Smalley the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1996. Natural fullerenes derived from Shungite has been proven to normalize cellular metabolism, increase enzymatic activity, stimulate the ability of tissues to regenerate, possess anti-inflammatory properties and act against toxins, neutralizing any toxins present in the body.

If you're feeling called toward a shungite pyramid, you're probably looking to immerse your space with balanced, focused and cleansed energy. This energy is known to increase your focus and sense of security as it neutralizes negative or chaotic vibrations. Maybe you need the shungite pyramid at work to help you stay emotionally balanced, even when you're under tight deadlines. Or maybe your spirit is drawn to a shungite pyramid because you need grounding and stability at home. Wherever you need to feel a surge of calm balance, bring a shungite pyramid into that space.
